summary: Apache Tomcat: Fix for CVE-2026-34500 was incomplete. OCSP checks sometimes soft-fail with FFM even when soft-fail is disabled
details:
CLIENT_CERT authentication does not fail as expected for some scenarios when soft fail is disabled vulnerability in Apache Tomcat.



This issue affects Apache Tomcat: from 11.0.0 through 11.0.25, from 10.1.22 through 10.1.59, from 9.0.92 through 9.0.121.



Users are recommended to upgrade to version 11.0.26, 10.1.60 or 9.0.122, which fix the issue.
